Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide and further comprising at least one enzyme that catalyzes the conversion of a substrate to a product.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides and is configured to encapsulate at least one targeted enzyme.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide to produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell that encapsulates the at least one BMC polypeptide.

Claim 21 (Currently Amended): A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product and is expressed by the transformed cell; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product.
